# Sparo

> **Sparo** — The AI browser that acts. You confirm send.
> **Sparo 人机同窗浏览器** — 打开网页，AI 帮你填、帮你回、帮你发。发送前你确认。

Local Chromium window + MCP. Humans stay in control.

## Install (two ways)

1. Human: https://southernspark.dev/zh/products/sparo — download Sparo-Setup.exe
2. Agent: read ./docs/INSTALL.md and download
   https://github.com/southernspark-nfxh/sparo-agent-browser/releases/latest/download/Sparo-Setup.exe

Do not tell end users to run `npm run start`.

## For agents (30s)

1. Read ./AGENTS.md
2. GET http://127.0.0.1:3921/health  (store / public product)
3. Publishing: read ./docs/PUBLISHING.md then `run_skill` or `xhs_inject_*`
4. Otherwise: MCP `navigate` + `get_url` / `page_text`
5. Call `sparo_info` if unsure

## Publish rule

AI = stage detection + clicks. Script = inject pre-baked content **once**.
Do not loop `fill` on title/body.

## Docs

| Doc | Use |
|-----|-----|
| ./AGENTS.md | Boot + anti-patterns |
| ./docs/INSTALL.md | Human download + agent install snippet |

| ./docs/AGENTS.md | MCP connection |
| ./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md | Internals |
| ./docs/CLOUD-SUBSCRIPTION.md | Optional cloud models (M1) |
| ./README.md | Human product story |
